admission.justification: Realized across role_launch_routes.py, paseo_bridge.py, and paseo_catalog_store.py, and proved by three disconnect tests in test_read_cancellation.py.

applicability: HTTP POST /api/role-launch/options requests guarded by read_while_connected when the client disconnects.
conditions: _run_bridge runs a pipe-draining Popen process group when read_cancellation() is bound, killing and reaping the child group and raising ReadCancelled on disconnect while keeping subprocess.run when unbound.
_merge_saved re-checks raise_if_read_cancelled() under the catalog store lock before publishing.
exclusions: An already-published atomic catalog snapshot written while connected stands if disconnect occurs later during receipt liveness reads; POST /api/role-launch/dispatch cancellation semantics are unchanged.
statement: A disconnected role-launch options request stops pending bridge work and returns 499, preserving the prior snapshot when cancellation is observed before publication.
title: Disconnected options requests stop bridge work, return 499, fence writes
